_comment: Paste these objects into the 'grants' array in agency-grants.json (or run scrape-agency.js once with these already in place). Each has manual: true so scrape-agency.js will preserve it on every future run. Status/dates below reflect what was on the live pages as of 2026-08-19 — verify and update before committing, especially dueDate values. CDBG and Pro-Housing Community Program are intentionally NOT included here — their real status/deadline couldn't be confirmed, so they're being left off the dashboard entirely rather than shown with a misleading status. Snowmobile Trail Grant is also intentionally excluded.

grants.title: Connect Kids to Parks Field Trip Grant Program
grants.agency: NYS Office of Parks, Recreation & Historic Preservation
grants.description: Reimburses transportation costs for school field trips to eligible locations. Applications accepted on a rolling basis.

grants.title: Connect Kids to Swimming Instruction Transportation Grant Program
grants.agency: NYS Office of Parks, Recreation & Historic Preservation
grants.description: Reimburses transportation costs to swim-instruction facilities. Applications accepted on a rolling basis.

grants.title: ZBGA Operational Support Grant
grants.agency: NYS Office of Parks, Recreation & Historic Preservation
grants.description: Funding for collections care or special projects at municipal or not-for-profit zoos, botanical gardens, and aquaria.

grants.title: LWCF Outdoor Recreation Legacy Partnership Program
grants.agency: NYS Office of Parks, Recreation & Historic Preservation
grants.description: Federal, nation-wide, urban-focused grant program targeted at creating or reinvigorating parks and outdoor recreation spaces.

grants.title: NYS HOME Program
grants.description: Funding for affordable housing development, down payment assistance, and rehabilitation for municipalities and nonprofits. 2026 Local Funding Round is open via CDOL.

grants.title: Municipal Permitting Modernization Program (PON 5862)
grants.description: $7.5 million available. Provides NYS municipalities (cities, towns, villages, counties) two years of no-cost access to Citizenserve, a software platform for building permitting, planning/zoning, code enforcement, and licensing. First-come, first-served; closes when funds are exhausted or by the deadline, whichever comes first.

grants.title: Charge Ready NY 2.0 (PON 5367)
grants.description: $12 million available. Incentives for installing Level 2 EV charging equipment at workplaces and multi-unit dwellings — $3,000 per port ($4,000 in Disadvantaged Communities). Municipalities, school districts, and other local government entities are eligible Equipment Owners. First-come, first-served; closes when funds are exhausted or by the deadline, whichever comes first.
